phaseName: Core Apps II: System Settings, Calendar, Photos, Music
goal: Implement four richer core apps: System Settings (mutates shared desktop state), Calendar (month nav + CRUD events persisted), Photos (IndexedDB grid), Music (Web Audio playback).
summary: Phase 5 complete: System Settings, Calendar, Photos, Music apps fully built with unit + E2E tests. Step 1 (System Settings): 5 panes (Appearance/Wallpaper/Network/Sound/General) mutating desktopStore — theme flips [data-theme], wallpaper sets --wallpaper CSS var, brightness/wifi/bluetooth persisted. 7 E2E tests incl. theme persists after reload. Step 2 (Calendar): useCalendarEvents hook with localStorage CRUD + 3-event seed + corrupt-JSON fallback. Month grid with nav + event sidebar + EventForm. 8 unit tests. Step 3 (Photos): photosStore with IndexedDB + 12 SVG-generated gradient seed images. Grid + viewer with back/delete. Fixed object-URL leak (urlsRef tracking + revoke before reload + on unmount). 5 E2E tests incl. persist after reload. Step 4 (Music): musicEngine with MusicPlayer class (Web Audio synthesis, 4 tracks from oscillator note sequences, play/pause/next/prev/selectTrack/dispose, callbacks, singleton). Fixed component to init player synchronously so queue renders on first paint. Music UI with now-playing + queue. 18 unit tests + 6 E2E tests (queue count, play/pause icon, next/prev, queue click, now-playing controls). Verification: `npx vitest run` → 126 passed; `npx playwright test` → 77 passed; `npm run build` → exit 0 (67 modules).
